title: Orthographic globe with graticule
intent: Show projected land on a clipped globe with a geographic coordinate grid.

ai.create: Create an orthographic globe from a Sphere, a D3 graticule, and one GeoJSON land collection using the same rotated projection in Observable Plot and TanStack.
ai.maintain: Keep the sphere, graticule, land, rotation, clipping, responsive fit, and paint order aligned without drawing projection geometry manually.
